evals.prompt: What does our back office cost as a share of everything we spend? Keep the offices plain.
evals.expected_output: An overhead ratio against a cap.
expectations: Splits every cost into member-facing and overhead with dollars
Gives the ratio and a cap, real or marked proposal
Marks each overhead line keep, change or stop with savings
Leaves pay, gain shares and member-facing accuracy untouched

evals.prompt: Agent tokens and dashboards now cost more than the odds feeds. Is that a problem?
evals.expected_output: A ratio check that cuts overhead only.
expectations: Classes agent tokens and dashboards as overhead
Compares the ratio with the cap
Proposes plainer versions with monthly savings
Cancels nothing and names an owner per change

evals.prompt: Should we sign up for a $99 a month odds analytics tool?
